item.title: The trust collapse: Infinite AI content is awful
item.description:

item.title: IKEA launches new smart home range with 21 Matter-compatible products
item.description:
📝 Published 6 November 2025 • Inter IKEA newsroomIKEA launches new smart home range with 21 Matter-compatible products IKEA is launching 21 new smart home products focusing on lighting, sensors, and control — all built to work with Matter, the universal smart home standard. With this launch, IKEA is rebuilding its smart home system and product range from the ground up. Lighting – The new smart bulb range from IKEA.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom/retail/the-new-smart-home-from-ikea-matter-compatible-251106/
